out a cheesecake cornet followed by these two amazing looking peppers that actually weren't peppers at all they were chocolate and for one of the desserts they brought out a 75 year old whiskey and actually a lot of fun and the whiskey smelled really great they then took us out to the patio area of the restaurant so that we could have some tea and some petite fours next up is azer mende a basque country region they then brought out the welcome picnic which included a pequilo ice cream which is basically a red pepper flavored ice cream a smoked brioche which was absolutely delicious a tartar of ibirako which is the ham from the region and a papara michelata which is similar to the mexican michelada beer in tomato juice drink they then took us into the kitchen to meet the chefs and restaurant but again this was probably the smallest pour of wine i've ever had at a restaurant next up was the iberian pork with isabel cheese bonbons and pesto which was paired with a delicious red wine they then brought out a giant snow cone machine that they said was a traditional type of dessert from the region and they made an iced mojito which was equally fun and delicious to drink they then brought out a dessert called herb infused curds with honey and a thousand flowers this dish was delicious and fun to eat and they paired it with a unique chocolate milk tasting liqueur they then brought out a sweet apple cider that paired nicely with the final dessert and it was called black olives and cocoa and it included an olive ice cream as well as a few other chocolate desserts we then got up and went to the final room that had an amazing view so we could enjoy some tea and some petite fours but we ended up asking for one of each and they gave us eight little different unique treats at fancy restaurants like these but when i do it's worth every penny because for me it's not just about the food it's an experience i'll remember for the rest of my life and it's a reminder of just how far i've come on my journey and i'm not saying any of this to brag because i don't think i'm special i think everything that i've done making the money and being able to travel is something that you and anyone else can do as well the problem is most people are stuck in a job where they have to work 40 50 60 hours a week and if they work their butt off at the end of the year they get a 5 raise
